constraints: metaName selects how metaContents is interpreted: a tag-path constant from the Picture Metadata Names theme (metaContents is then the value to set, of the Text/Longint/Real/Date/Time type matching that tag, an array if the tag holds multiple values, or an XML/XMP-formatted string), a block name ("TIFF", "EXIF", "GPS" or "IPTC"), or an empty string (metaContents is then the XML DOM reference of the element containing the metadata to set; an empty metaName modifies all metadata). If metaName is undefined, an empty string is used.
Passing an empty string ("") in metaContents for a tag-path metaName erases the existing metadata designated by that tag.
Only certain picture formats (notably JPEG and TIFF) support metadata; formats such as GIF or BMP do not, and converting a picture with metadata to a non-supporting format loses that metadata.
Some metadata are read-only and cannot be modified by this command, e.g. TIFF XResolution/YResolution, EXIF Color Space, EXIF Pixel X/Y Dimension.
On Windows, a failed metadata write sets the OK system variable to 0; on macOS, metadata write errors are not detected and OK is not modified.
Repeated (metaName;metaContents) pairs set several metadata items in one call.
